verdict.rationale: GitCafe has no native CI runner in the evidence. CI is delivered through a first-party Buildkite integration that shows builds on a repository's CI tab and as pull request checks, and GitHub-synced repositories receive GitHub Actions results as checks. Rulesets can then require those checks to pass. Missing for 10: a native pipeline-as-code runner, documentation that pipeline definitions live in the repository, explicit automatic triggering on pushes and pull requests, and independent hands-on corroboration.
